tool_schemas.name: get_file_report
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cached (or freshly fetched, if force_refresh=true) VirusTotal file report for the provided MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256, and may include our stored raw VirusTotal payload when include_raw=true. If a cached report exists and force_refresh=false, we return the cached artifact; otherwise we fetch from VirusTotal and update our cache before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when file_hash is not a valid MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 hex digest, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service, NOT_FOUND when VirusTotal has no record for the hash, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining VirusTotal lookup allowance for the requested operation.

file_hash.description: File hash to lookup (MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256).

include_raw.description: Whether to include the cached raw VirusTotal payload in the response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to force a fresh fetch from VirusTotal even if a cached report exists.

tool_schemas.name: get_url_report
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cached (or freshly fetched, if force_refresh=true) comprehensive VirusTotal URL report for the normalized URL, including scan verdicts plus our precomputed summaries for key relationships (for example communicating files, contacted domains/IPs, downloaded files, redirects, and related threat actors). If include_raw=true and we have it, the response also includes the cached raw VirusTotal payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when url is empty or cannot be normalized into a valid URL, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service, NOT_FOUND when VirusTotal has no record for the normalized URL, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining VirusTotal lookup allowance.

url.description: URL to analyze (will be normalized before lookup).

include_raw.description: Whether to include the cached raw VirusTotal payload in the response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to force a fresh fetch from VirusTotal even if a cached report exists.

tool_schemas.name: get_domain_report
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cached (or freshly fetched, if force_refresh=true) VirusTotal domain report for the given domain, including DNS/WHOIS-oriented fields and our summaries for key relationships such as historical SSL certificates, subdomains, resolutions, historical WHOIS, historical URLs, and related threat actors. If include_raw=true and available, we also return the cached raw VirusTotal payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when domain is empty/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service, NOT_FOUND when VirusTotal has no record for the domain, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining VirusTotal lookup allowance.

include_raw.description: Whether to include the cached raw VirusTotal payload in the response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to force a fresh fetch from VirusTotal even if a cached report exists.

tool_schemas.name: get_ip_report
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cached (or freshly fetched, if force_refresh=true) VirusTotal IP address report for the provided IPv4/IPv6, including reputation/geolocation-oriented fields and our summaries for key relationships such as communicating/downloaded files, resolutions, historical certificates/WHOIS, related URLs, and related threat actors. If include_raw=true and available, we also return the cached raw VirusTotal payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ip is empty or not a valid IPv4/IPv6 address, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service, NOT_FOUND when VirusTotal has no record for the IP, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining VirusTotal lookup allowance.

ip.description: IP address to analyze (IPv4 or IPv6).

include_raw.description: Whether to include the cached raw VirusTotal payload in the response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to force a fresh fetch from VirusTotal even if a cached report exists.

tool_schemas.name: get_file_behavior_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns a consolidated summary of VirusTotal behavior (sandbox) reports for the provided MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256, using a cached artifact unless force_refresh=true triggers a fresh fetch and cache update. When include_raw=true and available, we also include the cached raw VirusTotal behavior payload alongside the normalized summary. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when file_hash is not a valid MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 hex digest, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service, NOT_FOUND when VirusTotal has no behavior data for the hash, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining VirusTotal lookup allowance.

file_hash.description: File hash to retrieve the consolidated behavior (sandbox) summary for (MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256).

include_raw.description: Whether to include the cached raw VirusTotal payload in the response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to force a fresh fetch from VirusTotal even if a cached report exists.

tool_schemas.name: advanced_corpus_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a VT Intelligence corpus search using the provided query and returns a single page of matches sized by page_size (default service behavior if omitted), along with an opaque cursor you can pass back as cursor to fetch the next page. Results are paged exclusively via the cursor; when no further results exist we return an empty page and/or omit the next cursor as supported by the backend. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when query is empty or page_size is outside 1–100, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service, FORBIDDEN when the configured VirusTotal API key lacks Intelligence access, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has exhausted its Intelligence/search quota.

query.description: VT Intelligence query string (VT Intelligence syntax).

page_size.description: Number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def advanced_corpus_search(query, page_size=None, cursor=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0234000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0234000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "advanced_corpus_search"
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now_iso = now.isoformat() + "Z"
    day = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    if not isinstance(query, str) or len(query.strip()) < 1:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "query must be a non-empty string")
    q = query.strip()
    if page_size is None:
        page_size = 25
    if not isinstance(page_size, int):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_size must be an integer")
    if page_size < 1 or page_size > 100:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_size must be between 1 and 100")
    if cursor is not None and not isinstance(cursor, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cursor must be a string")

    clients = _load("api_clients.json")
    active = [c for c in clients if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("status") == "active" and c.get("intelligence_enabled") is True]
    if not active:
        # log as unauthorized
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        # choose any active client for logging if present, else None
        any_active = [c for c in clients if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("status") == "active"]
        cid = (sorted(any_active, key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""))[0].get("id") if any_active else None)
        logs.append({
            "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
            "timestamp": now_iso,
            "day": day,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "client_id": cid,
            "status": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "upstream_requests": 0,
            "relationship_pages": 0,
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "VT Intelligence is not enabled for this client")

    client = sorted(active, key=lambda c: c.get("created_at", ""))[0]
    client_id = client.get("id")

    # quota check: every page fetch is one upstream request
    logs = _load("request_logs.json")
    if not isinstance(logs, list):
        logs = []
    todays = [r for r in logs if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("client_id") == client_id and r.get("day") == day]
    used = sum(1 for r in todays if r.get("upstream_requests", 0))
    dq = client.get("daily_quota_requests")
    if not isinstance(dq, int) or dq < 0:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Client daily_quota_requests is invalid")
    if used + 1 > dq:
        logs.append({
            "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso+'|quota').encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
            "timestamp": now_iso,
            "day": day,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "client_id": client_id,
            "status": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "upstream_requests": 0,
            "relationship_pages": 0,
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily request quota exceeded", daily_quota_requests=dq)

    jobs = _load("search_jobs.json")
    if not isinstance(jobs, list):
        jobs = []

    # Cursor format: "job:<id>:<offset>"
    job = None
    offset = 0
    if cursor:
        parts = cursor.split(":")
        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] != "job" or not parts[2].isdigit():
            # invalid cursor treated as validation error
            logs.append({
                "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso+'|badcursor').encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
                "timestamp": now_iso,
                "day": day,
                "endpoint": endpoint,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "status": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "upstream_requests": 0,
                "relationship_pages": 0,
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cursor is invalid")
        jid = parts[1]
        offset = int(parts[2])
        for j in jobs:
            if isinstance(j, dict) and j.get("id") == jid:
                job = j
                break
        if job is None:
            logs.append({
                "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso+'|noj').encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
                "timestamp": now_iso,
                "day": day,
                "endpoint": endpoint,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "status": "NOT_FOUND",
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "upstream_requests": 0,
                "relationship_pages": 0,
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Search job not found for provided cursor")
        if job.get("client_id") != client_id:
            logs.append({
                "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso+'|unauthjob').encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
                "timestamp": now_iso,
                "day": day,
                "endpoint": endpoint,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "status": "UNAUTHORIZED",
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "upstream_requests": 0,
                "relationship_pages": 0,
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Cursor does not belong to this client")
        if job.get("query") != q:
            logs.append({
                "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso+'|qmis').encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
                "timestamp": now_iso,
                "day": day,
                "endpoint": endpoint,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "status": "CONFLICT",
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "upstream_requests": 0,
                "relationship_pages": 0,
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
            return _err("CONFLICT", "query does not match the cursor's search job")
        if job.get("status") == "cancelled":
            logs.append({
                "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso+'|canc').encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
                "timestamp": now_iso,
                "day": day,
                "endpoint": endpoint,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "status": "INVALID_TRANSITION",
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "upstream_requests": 0,
                "relationship_pages": 0,
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Search job is cancelled")

        # allow completed -> running transition (per lifecycle)
        if job.get("status") in ("completed", "error"):
            job["status"] = "running"
            job["updated_at"] = now_iso

    # create job if needed
    if job is None:
        jid = f"sj_{hashlib.sha256((client_id+'|'+q+'|'+now_iso).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}"
        job = None
        for j in jobs:
            if isinstance(j, dict) and j.get("id") == jid:
                job = j
                break
        if job is None:
            job = {
                "id": jid,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "query": q,
                "status": "running",
                "page_size": page_size,
                "next_cursor": None,
                "result_items": [],
                "total_estimated": None,
                "last_fetched_at": None,
                "error_message": None,
                "created_at": now_iso,
                "updated_at": now_iso,
            }
            jobs.append(job)
        offset = 0

    # simulate upstream page results deterministically
    seed = hashlib.sha256((client_id + "|" + q).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    total = 250 + (int(seed[:2], 16) % 500)  # 250..749
    job["total_estimated"] = total

    items = []
    for i in range(offset, min(offset + page_size, total)):
        h = hashlib.sha256((seed + "|" + str(i)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        items.append({
            "id": f"file:{h[:64]}",
            "type": "file",
            "sha256": h[:64],
            "first_seen": None,
            "score": (int(h[64-2:64], 16) % 100) / 100.0,
        })

    next_off = offset + len(items)
    next_cursor = None
    if next_off < total:
        next_cursor = f"job:{job.get('id')}:{next_off}"

    job["page_size"] = page_size
    job["last_fetched_at"] = now_iso
    job["next_cursor"] = next_cursor
    job["updated_at"] = now_iso
    job["result_items"] = items  # cache current page

    if next_cursor is None:
        # running -> completed
        job["status"] = "completed"
    else:
        job["status"] = "running"

    _save("search_jobs.json", jobs)

    # log success
    logs.append({
        "id": f"log_{hashlib.sha256((endpoint+'|'+now_iso+'|ok').encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}",
        "timestamp": now_iso,
        "day": day,
        "endpoint": endpoint,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "status": "OK",
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        "upstream_requests": 1,
        "relationship_pages": 0,
    })
    _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    return {
        "data": {
            "query": q,
            "page_size": page_size,
            "items": items,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            "total_estimated": total,
            "job_id": job.get("id"),
            "status": job.get("status"),
        }
    }

tool_schemas.name: get_file_relationship
tool_schemas.description: Returns one page of relationship items of the requested relationship_type for the given file hash, limited by limit (1–100), and includes an opaque cursor for continuing pagination when more items exist. We serve relationship rows from cache when available and otherwise fetch from VirusTotal as needed to fulfill the requested page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when file_hash is not a valid MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 digest, when relationship_type is not one of the supported enums, or when limit is outside 1–100; UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service; NOT_FOUND when the file hash does not exist in VirusTotal; and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining allowance for relationship retrieval.

file_hash.description: File hash to query relationships for (MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256).

relationship_type.description: Relationship type to retrieve for the file observable.

limit.description: Maximum number of relationship items to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of relationship items.

tool_schemas.name: get_url_relationship
tool_schemas.description: Returns one page of relationship items of the requested relationship_type for the normalized URL, limited by limit (1–100), and includes an opaque cursor for fetching the next page. We use cached relationship edges when present and otherwise fetch from VirusTotal to satisfy the requested page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when url is empty/cannot be normalized, when relationship_type is not one of the supported enums, or when limit is outside 1–100; UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service; NOT_FOUND when the normalized URL does not exist in VirusTotal; and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining allowance for relationship retrieval.

url.description: URL to query relationships for (will be normalized before lookup).

relationship_type.description: Relationship type to retrieve for the URL observable.

limit.description: Maximum number of relationship items to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of relationship items.

tool_schemas.name: get_domain_relationship
tool_schemas.description: Returns one page of domain relationship items for domain and relationship_type, limited by limit (1–100), plus a VirusTotal cursor token you can pass back as cursor to continue pagination. By default we serve cached relationship rows scoped to client_id, and when refresh=true we force a fresh fetch from VirusTotal before returning the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when client_id is not a vtc_cli_ ULID, when domain is empty/invalid, when relationship_type is not supported, or when limit is outside 1–100; UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service; NOT_FOUND when the domain does not exist in VirusTotal; and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining allowance for relationship retrieval.

client_id.description: API client ULID (vtc_cli_...) used for quota enforcement and cache scoping.

domain.description: Domain name to retrieve relationship data for (e.g., example.com).

relationship_type.description: Domain relationship type to page through.

limit.description: Maximum number of relationship items to return in this page.

cursor.description: VirusTotal cursor token to continue pagination from a prior page.

refresh.description: If true, forces a fresh fetch from VirusTotal instead of using only cached relationship rows.

tool_schemas.name: get_ip_relationship
tool_schemas.description: Returns one page of IP relationship items for the provided IPv4/IPv6 and relationship_type, limited by limit (1–100), and includes a cursor token to continue pagination when more results are available. We serve cached relationship edges when present and otherwise fetch from VirusTotal to fulfill the requested page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ip is empty or not a valid IPv4/IPv6 address, when relationship_type is not supported, or when limit is outside 1–100; UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use this service; NOT_FOUND when the IP does not exist in VirusTotal; and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining allowance for relationship retrieval.

client_id.description: API client ULID (vtc_cli_...) used for quota enforcement and cache scoping.

ip.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to retrieve relationship data for.

relationship_type.description: IP relationship type to page through.

limit.description: Maximum number of relationship items to return in this page.

cursor.description: VirusTotal cursor token to continue pagination from a prior page.

refresh.description: If true, forces a fresh fetch from VirusTotal instead of using only cached relationship rows.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_client
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client identity for the presented credential, including current status, enabled features, effective scopes, and current UTC-day quota consumption for requests and relationship pages. Refuses requests when the credential is missing/invalid or the client is not allowed to view its own metadata.

api_key.description: VirusTotal MCP API key used to authenticate the caller (presented as provided; the service matches it against the stored api_key_hash).

tool_schemas.name: create_search_job
tool_schemas.description: Creates a VT Intelligence search job for the authenticated client and fetches the first page of results, persisting the cursor for subsequent pagination. Returns the created job record including job id, status, first result_items page, total_estimated when available, and next_cursor. Refuses when the client is not active, VT Intelligence is not enabled for the client, the query is invalid, or the daily request quota would be exceeded.

api_key.description: VirusTotal MCP API key used to authenticate the caller (presented as provided; the service matches it against the stored api_key_hash).

query.description: VT Intelligence query string (VT Intelligence syntax).

page_size.description: Number of items to request per page from VT Intelligence. If omitted, the service default is used.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search job by id for the authenticated client, returning its current status, last_fetched_at, next_cursor, and the most recently stored result_items page. Refuses when the job does not exist, is owned by a different client, the credential is invalid, or the client is not active.

api_key.description: VirusTotal MCP API key used to authenticate the caller (presented as provided; the service matches it against the stored api_key_hash).

tool_schemas.name: list_search_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists VT Intelligence search jobs owned by the authenticated client with optional filtering by status, ordered by most recently updated. Returns a paged list of jobs (excluding large result payloads unless include_items=true). Refuses when the credential is invalid or the client is not active.

api_key.description: VirusTotal MCP API key used to authenticate the caller (presented as provided; the service matches it against the stored api_key_hash).

status.description: Optional filter to return only jobs in the given status.

include_items.description: Whether to include the stored result_items page for each job (may increase response size).

page_size.description: Number of jobs to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_job_page
tool_schemas.description: Continues pagination for an existing VT Intelligence search job owned by the authenticated client, fetching the next page using the job's stored next_cursor and updating the job record. Returns the updated job fields along with the newly fetched result_items page. Refuses when the client is not active, VT Intelligence is not enabled, the job is not owned by the caller, the job is cancelled, there is no next_cursor to fetch, or the daily request quota would be exceeded.

api_key.description: VirusTotal MCP API key used to authenticate the caller (presented as provided; the service matches it against the stored api_key_hash).

search_job_id.description: Search job id to fetch the next page for.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_search_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a running VT Intelligence search job owned by the authenticated client, transitioning status to cancelled and preventing further pagination. Returns the updated job record. Refuses when the job does not exist, is owned by a different client, is already cancelled, the credential is invalid, or the client is not active.

api_key.description: VirusTotal MCP API key used to authenticate the caller (presented as provided; the service matches it against the stored api_key_hash).
